description.narrative: 1.3. WTO TFA Cat C commitments implemented

comment.narrative: Three WTO TFA Cat C commitments NSW AEO and Prearrival processing and risk management Cat B implemented .

On 19 August 2022 Cambodia notified to the WTO the definite dates for implementation of the 6 TFA Category C Articles as 31 December 2023 for Art 1.4 Notification and 7.7 AEO and 31 December 2025 for Art. 7.1 PreArrival Processing 8.2 Border Agency Cooperation 10.4 Single Window and 11.5 Transit. In its communication to the WTO Cambodia also mentions the Arise Plus Cambodia projects support on the NCTF website and the NTR as contributions to the implementation of TFA Art. 1.4.In February 2021 TFA Article 7.9 on Perishable Goods was shifted from Category C to Category B. ARISE Plus Cambodia has not contributed to this shift between categories.
